name: custom-shell-app-router-configs-and-layout
description: Routing configuration and layout handling in a React app shell, horizontal split. Step 1: four standalone apps, not yet federated.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix shell install && npm --prefix product-mfe install && npm --prefix cart-mfe install && npm --prefix user-mfe install
scripts.dev:all: npm --prefix shell run dev & npm --prefix product-mfe run dev & npm --prefix cart-mfe run dev & npm --prefix user-mfe run dev & wait
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix product-mfe run build && npm --prefix cart-mfe run build && npm --prefix user-mfe run build && npm --prefix shell run build
scripts.preview:all: trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT TERM; npm --prefix shell run preview & npm --prefix product-mfe run preview & npm --prefix cart-mfe run preview & npm --prefix user-mfe run preview & wait
